select g.* from goods g left join self_goods_brand b on g.brand_id=b.brand_id where is_select = 1
and g.type_id=#{typeId}
and (g.title like concat('%',#{title},'%') or b.brand_name like concat('%',#{title},'%'))
order by g.create_at desc

select g.* from goods g left join self_goods_brand b on g.brand_id=b.brand_id where 1=1
and g.three_type_id=#{threeTypeId}
and g.brand_id=#{brandId}
and (g.title like concat('%',#{title},'%') or b.brand_name like concat('%',#{title},'%'))
ORDER BY g.daily_rent DESC
ORDER BY g.daily_rent ASC
ORDER BY g.create_at DESC
